title: Integral bound for a truncated tail
statement: Let $U,T\in\mathbb{R}$ with $1\le T$, and define $g(t)=U$ for $t\le T$ and $g(t)=4\exp(-t^2/2)$ for $t>T$. Then the integral of $g$ over $t>0$ is at most $UT+4\exp(-T^2/2)$.
